name: 91604 · Studio City, CA
findings: ZIP 91604 (Studio City) has 184 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91604 (Studio City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 91604 (Studio City) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.6 times the typical level).
